liam_support: Hi team — customer ACME reports our function chooser picked the wrong tool in prod, causing a bad charge. They say the system invoked `price_lookup` when the prompt asked for `product_lookup`. Request and returned args below. Can someone triage?

acme_cust: @liam_support here's the original request we sent: `{"input":"Find SKU 12345 info","functions":["product_lookup","price_lookup"]}` We got back: `{"invoked":"price_lookup","args":"{\"sku\":\"12345\",\"currency\":\"USD\"}"}` The response was impossible for our product endpoint and we were billed.

olivia_support: Sorry about that — tagging eng-ml + runtime. Do you have a request_id or time window?

liam_support: Request ID `req_0a9c3b` at 2024-06-27T14:10:23Z (approx). Customer provided full transcripts and a sample curl to repro.

acme_cust: repro curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-v1","input":"Find SKU 12345 info","functions":[{"name":"product_lookup","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"}}}},{"name":"price_lookup","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"currency":{"type":"string"}}}]}'
```

devon_eng-ml: Thanks — quick hypothesis: the selector heuristic we rolled in #codeline a few days ago gives price_lookup higher score when `currency` token appears in the prompt or in our golden prompts. Could be a bad training signal in the tool-choice ranker.

sara_eng-runtime: On the runtime side I see a couple of near-simultaneous delegations for `req_0a9c3b`. Log snippet: ```
[2024-06-27T14:10:23Z] req_0a9c3b tool_routing: chosen=price_lookup score=0.78 fallback=product_lookup score=0.45 route=us-east-1
[2024-06-27T14:10:23Z] req_0a9c3b invoke price_lookup args={"sku":"12345","currency":"USD"} status=200
```

olivia_support: Is this a one-off or did our toolcall regression CI pick this up? We had a golden eval fail earlier but I thought it was flaky.

devon_eng-ml: Our toolcall eval suite shows a new failure in `golden-tool-choice-suite` after commit `c9f2a7`. Failing test: expectation was `product_lookup` but result `price_lookup`. Diff attached in CI: ```
- expected: product_lookup
+ actual: price_lookup
- expected args: {"sku":"<id>"}
+ actual args: {"sku":"<id>","currency":"USD"}
```

devon_eng-ml: I ran the local reproducer with the eval harness and could reproduce 1/10 runs. Seems nondeterministic — likely model drift + ranking threshold.

sara_eng-runtime: Can we short-term patch by lowering selection threshold for price_lookup or pin the model variant? Which variant was serving?

devon_eng-ml: Serving variant `rwd-compact-v1.2.3` (weights pinned in prod config). We reverted a ranking feature flag last night but maybe the rollout didn't cover all regions.

liam_support: Customer wants remediation: refund for the incorrect billing and a plan to stop mis-invokes ASAP. I'll coordinate with finance once eng confirms scope.

olivia_support: Agreed. Devon/sara — what are next steps and ETA?

devon_eng-ml: Short term: add a deterministic filter in routing that favors exact schema match for tool names when confidence delta < 0.35. I can push to staging in ~2h and to canary region in ~4h. Also adding a golden test that asserts `product_lookup` for the ACME prompt.

sara_eng-runtime: I'll add a runtime rollback flag to force `product_lookup` for req_0a9c3b pattern in us-east-1 while we verify. Can enable within 30min.

devon_eng-ml: Also opening an eval PR to expand the tool-choice golden suite with ACME's prompt and add fuzz cases to catch currency-token contamination. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tool-evals/pull/482

liam_support: Perfect. I'll tell the customer: temporary rollback + refund pending verification.

acme_cust: Thanks — appreciate quick help. Please keep me posted in this thread.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered by sara_eng-runtime for rollback flag (canary-us-east). Build `rollback-toolflag-20240627` queued.

devon_eng-ml: Postmortem action items: 1) Add strict schema-preference check in selector 2) Expand golden prompt suite 3) Add metric for "incorrect tool invoked" to Alerts dashboard 4) Add regression CI job that runs golden-tool-choice on multiple seeds.

olivia_support: I'll follow up with finance about the charge and draft the customer note. Closing loop later today. :thumbsup:
